detail: The Politically Exposed Person (PEP) and sanctions screening report on file is in the name 'James Whitfield', which doesn't appear to match any party in this case (client: Joe Bloggs; donor: John Bloggs Senior). Worth confirming whether the document was misfiled from another matter and whether screening was completed for the actual case parties.
reference: Firm AML Policy §5.1 (PEP and sanctions screening)
title: Politically Exposed Person Check Appears to Be for the Wrong Individual
